collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A villager hoped to be chosen as the new net-maker, but their close friend was chosen instead.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1) hoped to be chosen as the new net-maker, but their close friend was chosen instead.

choices.label: Ask to Learn from the Friend.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The friend is delighted, and their bond grows stronger.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The words come out stiffly, but the friend appreciates the effort.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The friend understands and offers to share some of the work.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The conversation is awkward, but both feel better afterward.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: After a day alone, the villager congratulates the friend warmly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The friend notices the distance and asks gently what is wrong.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friend teaches eagerly, and the villager's skills grow.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The villager realizes they would rather pursue a different craft entirely.
